note: Rewritten from the species-level description in Roonwal & Chhotani 1989, Fauna of India: Isoptera; the original is in English and covers three castes: Imago, Soldier and Pseudo worker. OCR problems: the corrupt forms 'yellowish whitev', 'subrec^ngular' and 'clulvshaped/jomted/pilosei' were read correctly from context; the c in 'c 8.60-9.75' stands for circa and is rendered as 'about'. Distribution in the original is known only from the type locality, Nilambur, Kerala, India.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate body (without wings) 8.60—9.75 mm long, 15.50—17.30 mm with wings; soldier body 10.00—11.90 mm long, postmentum 2.20—2.55 mm long, pronotal width about equal to head width (index 0.95—1.04); pseudoworker body about 7.20—8.30 mm. Tibial spur formula 3:3:3 in all castes, tarsi 4-segmented, cerci 2-segmented.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule yellow-brown to dark reddish brown; pronotum brown to dark brown; antennae and legs pale yellow; body yellowish white. Head and pronotum sparsely pilose, body more densely so. Body length (without wings) about 8.60—9.75 mm, with wings about 15.50—17.30 mm. Head capsule subquadrate (head length (to mandible base) 1.50—1.65 mm, head width 1.55—1.75 mm), posteriorly rounded; with long setae; Y-shaped suture distinct; frons gently sloping forwards. Compound eyes subcircular (maximum diameter 0.50—0.58 mm, minimum diameter 0.48—0.55 mm), closely appressed to the antennal sockets, eye to antennal socket distance 0.03—0.05 mm. Ocelli large, oval (maximum diameter 0.20—0.25 mm, minimum diameter 0.13—0.18 mm), broadly contacting the compound eyes. Antennae 17—18-segmented; segment 3 about as long as segment 2 or shorter, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus subrectangular, darker than the frons; anteclypeus white, trapezoidal. Labrum tongue-shaped, anterior margin convex. Mandibles of the Neotermes type. Pronotum flat, subrectangular, sides rounded (length 1.00—1.05 mm, width 1.68—1.88 mm), slightly wider than the head width including the compound eyes; anterior margin broadly concave, posterior margin weakly concave. Femora weakly inflated; tibiae slender, tibial spur formula 3:3:3; tarsi 4-segmented. Wing membrane uncoloured, weakly tuberculate. Fore wing 14.00—15.2 mm long; subcosta distinct, meeting the costa at 1/8 of the wing base; radius meeting the costa about mid-wing; radial sector with 5—7 branches to the costa; media with up to 4 transverse branches to the radial sector; cubitus distinct, the basal veins coloured, with 18—20 main branches. Hind wing 12.2—12.4 mm long; radius meeting the costa slightly beyond mid-wing; media arising from the radial sector slightly before the middle of the wing membrane; cubitus with 15—18 branches. Abdomen long, cerci 2-segmented.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellow-brown to dark reddish brown; antennal base dark brown, darker apically; mandibular base dark reddish brown, nearly black apically; pronotum paler than the head capsule; abdomen pale yellow. Head and pronotum sparsely pilose, body more densely so. Body length 10.00—11.90 mm. Head capsule subrectangular (head length (to mandible base) 3.20—3.50 mm, head width 2.0—2.18 mm); sides nearly parallel, dorsal surface of head flat; Y-shaped suture distinct; frons gently sloping forwards. Compound eyes large, elongate-oval (maximum diameter 0.18—0.38 mm, minimum diameter 0.10—0.25 mm); eye to antennal socket distance 0.13—0.23 mm. Ocelli absent. Antennae 12—15-segmented; segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus subrectangular; anteclypeus trapezoidal, white. Labrum subsquare, with several setae on the anterior margin and on the body. Mandibles short and stout, slightly longer than half the head length (to mandible base) (length 1.70—1.95 mm, mandible length/head length index 0.50—0.57); basal elevation prominent, apex weakly incurved. Left mandible with 5, right mandible with 2 marginal teeth. Postmentum club-shaped, long (length 2.20—2.55 mm); widest anteriorly (maximum width 0.73—0.85 mm), narrowing posteriorly into a long waist (minimum width at the waist 0.28—0.43 mm), widening again towards the base; anterior margin nearly straight. Pronotum subrectangular, as wide as the head (width 1.95—2.25 mm, length 1.05—1.20 mm, pronotal width/head width index 0.95—1.04); anterior margin concave with a distinct median notch, posterior margin nearly straight. Legs short and slender; tibial spur formula 3:3:3; tarsi 4-segmented. Abdomen oval, cerci 2-segmented, styli 1-segmented.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Given as pseudo worker in the original. Head capsule pale; postclypeus pale to deep straw yellow; labrum and the rest of the body paler. Head and pronotum sparsely pilose, body more densely so. Body about 7.20—8.30 mm long. Head capsule subcircular (head length (to mandible base) 1.45—1.75 mm, head width 1.65—1.78 mm); Y-shaped suture not visible. Compound eyes flush with the surface of the head, white, small; maximum diameter 0.18—0.23 mm, minimum diameter 0.13—0.15 mm. Ocelli absent. Antennae short, 14—18-segmented, segment 2 longer than segment 3, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus flat; anteclypeus white, trapezoidal. Labrum dome-shaped. Mandibles of the Neotermes type. Pronotum subrectangular (width 1.70—1.85 mm, length 0.85—1.00 mm); anterior margin concave, posterior margin nearly straight. Legs short, tibial spur formula 3:3:3; tarsi 4-segmented. Abdomen long; cerci 2-segmented; styli 1-segmented.
